topic: Duties and responsibilities of SAEO/SALO and responsibilities for armament and explosive.
syllabus_extract: Duties and responsibilities of SAEO/SALO and responsibilities for armament and explosive. Brief about command and control during embarked and disembarked period, Introduction to passenger flight, Carriage of explosive on aircraft.
specific_objectives: 4.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain importance of INAP 2, and Duties and responsibilities of SAEO/SALO and responsibilities for armament and explosive and categories of INAS.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of INAP-2 excerpts and classification of explosives; Instructor supervision required for safety protocols.
intro_questions: What is the full form of INAP?
Who is responsible for armament and explosive safety on board?
What are the two main periods regarding command and control for embarked personnel?

development.content:
Importance of INAP-2
Duties of SAEO
Duties of SALO
Command and control embarked
Command and control disembarked

Introduction to passenger flight
Carriage of explosive on aircraft
Categories of INAS
Safety handling procedures
Documentation requirements

Review of SAEO/SALO roles
Explosive classification summary
Key safety protocols
Incident reporting basics
Final Q&A session

summary_questions: Explain the primary difference between SAEO and SALO responsibilities.
List three categories of INAS and their significance.
Describe the command structure during the disembarked period.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the reclassification of aircraft and engine nomenclature as covered in the next lesson plan (LP 03).

pft_rows.syllabus: Definition of terms (Airframe, Custodian, Allotment, UE, UH), Aircraft/Engine Nomenclature and Aircraft classification, Reclassification of aircraft and its authority
